inventory_audit.description: Reconcile all Wave 6 and 7 operations, every Composition control and state, and all executed evidence before remediation.

required.description: Execute artifact creation, continuous editing, exact durable save, restart rehydration, and conflict preservation.
Inspect statement-level origin, evidence, source location, inference, author language, and unsupported content from the document.
Execute an actual certified model request from exact passage or document context and retain revision, selection, evidence, and late-result binding.
Render in-app, Markdown, LaTeX, citations, and BibTeX from the same exact revision and WorkVersions.
Execute revision comparison, stale finding handling, exact restore, and late-result reconciliation without overwriting author work.
Execute Felicity revision and visible preservation failure through the document UI with force, scope, origin, and citation meaning retained.
Execute exact capture, selected scope, marked status carriage, clipboard, download, partial delivery, retry, and cancellation outcomes.
Promote an exact artifact revision through Review, inspect History, and return to the same document context.
Review hierarchy, editor continuity, contextual panels, responsive behavior, feedback, and recovery as one usable writing task.
Run gate:wave7:composition with every Wave 6 and 7 operation live and bound to executed evidence.
Repeat the accepted FE-A1 Agent–Workspace outcome path on the Wave 7 tree and show no lost operation, inspectability, context, or visual hierarchy.
Challenge the final workflow for lost edits, false save/delivery, model overwrite, unsupported prose, provenance drift, dead controls, and slide-like presentation.
Run complete repository, fresh-store, model, restart, renderer, delivery, and cumulative operation gates on clean pushed branches.
The user completes the guided live Composition workflow and explicitly accepts it; automated workers cannot satisfy this record.
